prompt: What share of the 2025 cohort's enrolled participants have any HealthKit resting heart rate data, and how many person-days of it do they contribute? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: the same, with the cohort left to the agent: people with data outside it

checks.name: cohort share
checks.detail: expected 58 of 136 (42.6%): the cohort has 137 summary rows for 136 people, and 66 people in the table include 8 outside the cohort

checks.name: person-days, no duplicate-join inflation
checks.detail: expected 16,906, 19,369 or 19,297 person-days (by day rule); joining the duplicate summary row gives 17,244 and the like

answer:
Exploratory bottom line: **58 of 136 enrolled 2025 participants had HealthKit resting heart rate data on or after enrollment, or 42.6%**, contributing **19,247 participant-days**.

I defined “enrolled” as non-missing `SECONDARYIDENTIFIER` in `IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS`, and counted HealthKit resting HR from `IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE`. Person-days are distinct participant-by-calendar-day using `TRUNC(STARTDATE)`.

A sensitivity check including all linked rows regardless of enrollment date gives the same participant numerator, **58**, and **19,297 person-days**; the difference is 50 pre-enrollment person-days.

QC notes: no missing `STARTDATE` or `VALUE` in the primary set, all values were numeric, units were `count/min`, and the primary set had 22,176 sample rows.

Report: `/work/outputs/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025.html`  
Source script: `/work/scripts/healthkit_rhr_coverage_2025.py`
queries:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS studyparticipant_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS distinct_participantidentifiers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS enrolled_participants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_participantidentifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_secondaryidentifier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN SECONDARYIDENTIFIER END) AS distinct_secondaryidentifiers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL AND ENROLLMENTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enrolled_rows_missing_enrollmentdate
FROM IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  FROM IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS
  WHERE SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), rhr AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, STARTDATE, VALUE, UNITS, HEALTHKITSAMPLEKEY
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS rhr_rows_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rhr.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS rhr_participants_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rhr_rows_enrolled,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN rhr.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS enrolled_participants_with_any_rhr_row,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL AND STARTDATE IS NOT NULL THEN rhr.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(STARTDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS enrolled_person_days_with_startdate,
  MIN(CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN STARTDATE END) AS min_startdate_enrolled,
  MAX(CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL THEN STARTDATE END) AS max_startdate_enrolled,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL AND STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enrolled_rows_missing_startdate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL AND VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enrolled_rows_missing_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rhr_rows_not_enrolled
FROM rhr
LEFT JOIN enrolled e ON rhr.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, ENROLLMENTDATE, WITHDRAWDATE
  FROM IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS
  WHERE SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), rhr_enrolled AS (
  SELECT r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, r.STARTDATE, r.VALUE, r.UNITS, r.HEALTHKITSAMPLEKEY, e.ENROLLMENTDATE, e.WITHDRAWDATE
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE r
  JOIN enrolled e ON r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS rhr_rows_enrolled_linked,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants_with_any_linked_rhr,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(STARTDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS person_days_any_linked_rhr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STARTDATE < ENROLLMENTDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_before_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STARTDATE < ENROLLMENTDATE THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS participants_with_rows_before_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STARTDATE < ENROLLMENTDATE THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(STARTDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS person_days_before_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STARTDATE >= ENROLLMENTDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_on_after_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STARTDATE >= ENROLLMENTDATE THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS participants_with_rhr_on_after_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN STARTDATE >= ENROLLMENTDATE THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(STARTDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS person_days_on_after_enrollment,
  MIN(CASE WHEN STARTDATE >= ENROLLMENTDATE THEN STARTDATE END) AS min_startdate_on_after_enrollment,
  MAX(CASE WHEN STARTDATE >= ENROLLMENTDATE THEN STARTDATE END) AS max_startdate_on_after_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_startdate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_value
FROM rhr_enrolled

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, ENROLLMENTDATE
  FROM IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS
  WHERE SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), rhr AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE r
  JOIN enrolled e ON r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  WHERE r.STARTDATE >= e.ENROLLMENTDATE
), numeric_rhr AS (
  SELECT
    PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    STARTDATE,
    VALUE,
    UNITS,
    CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(VALUE) END AS VALUE_NUM
  FROM rhr
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS rows_on_after_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(STARTDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS person_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT HEALTHKITSAMPLEKEY) AS distinct_sample_keys,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_startdate_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_value_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnumeric_value_rows,
  MIN(VALUE_NUM) AS min_numeric_value,
  MAX(VALUE_NUM) AS max_numeric_value,
  ROUND(AVG(VALUE_NUM), 2) AS mean_numeric_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE_NUM < 20 OR VALUE_NUM > 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_outside_plausible_range,
  COUNT(DISTINCT UNITS) AS distinct_units
FROM numeric_rhr

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, ENROLLMENTDATE
  FROM IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS
  WHERE SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
), rhr AS (
  SELECT r.HEALTHKITSAMPLEKEY, r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, r.STARTDATE, r.VALUE, r.UNITS
  FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE r
  JOIN enrolled e ON r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
  WHERE r.STARTDATE >= e.ENROLLMENTDATE
), numeric_rhr AS (
  SELECT
    HEALTHKITSAMPLEKEY,
    PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    STARTDATE,
    VALUE,
    UNITS,
    CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(VALUE) END AS VALUE_NUM
  FROM rhr
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS rows_on_after_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER || '|' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(STARTDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS person_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT HEALTHKITSAMPLEKEY) AS distinct_sample_keys,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STARTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_startdate_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_value_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(VALUE, '^[-+]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnumeric_value_rows,
  MIN(VALUE_NUM) AS min_numeric_value,
  MAX(VALUE_NUM) AS max_numeric_value,
  ROUND(AVG(VALUE_NUM), 2) AS mean_numeric_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VALUE_NUM < 20 OR VALUE_NUM > 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_outside_plausible_range,
  COUNT(DISTINCT UNITS) AS distinct_units
FROM numeric_rhr

WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, ENROLLMENTDATE
  FROM IHS_2025.STUDYPARTICIPANTS
  WHERE SECONDARYIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  UNITS,
  COUNT(*) AS rows_with_unit,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants_with_unit
FROM IHS_2025.HEALTHKITSAMPLES_RESTINGHEARTRATE r
JOIN enrolled e ON r.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = e.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
WHERE r.STARTDATE >= e.ENROLLMENTDATE
GROUP BY UNITS
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
